# When gen_mainline_lock.py Slot 69 has already run this calendar month, oe_sub_ran_m == oe_sub_m_now and this is skipped.
# Also covers non-BYZ overlords (CHI/YUA/RUS/etc.) on quarterly months with near-zero overhead.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_sub_fallback_pulse } }

oe_sub_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        current_year >= 1200
        is_rebel_country = no
        OR = {
            current_month = 1
            current_month = 4
            current_month = 7
            current_month = 10

        NOT = { var:oe_sub_ran_m ?= oe_sub_m_now }
        OR = {
            has_variable = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt
            has_variable = oe_sub_has_ward
            any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_sub_monthly = yes
    }
}
